subject: history_social
passage: The Rosetta Stone, found in Egypt in 1799, records a single royal decree in three scripts: hieroglyphs, Demotic, and ancient Greek. Because the scholars who studied it could already read Greek, the stone gave ______ a way to work out the meaning of the other two scripts, though fully deciphering the hieroglyphs still took more than twenty years.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The ones who were given a way to work out the other scripts are "the scholars," a plural noun. The pronoun is also the object of "gave," so it must be the plural object pronoun "them."
explanation.A: Correct. "Them" is plural, matching "scholars," and is the object form needed after "gave."
explanation.B: Incorrect. "It" is singular, but it must refer to the plural "scholars"; the stone did not give a way to itself or to the Greek text.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "They" is a subject pronoun; after the verb "gave," the object form "them" is needed.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Him" is singular and refers to no one in the text; the antecedent "scholars" is plural.

checks.note: Best fit on the text alone.
